$comment: Kharcha app release control file — the single source for GET /api/app-version.
Release a new version: build the APK in FlutLab, add it to a GitHub release
of this repo, then update version / versionCode / apkUrl / releaseNotes here
and push. versionCode is the ONLY comparison value the apps use.
While apkUrl is empty (or enabled is false) the endpoint answers 404 and the
download buttons show the coming-soon state — nothing breaks.
apkUrl may be a direct GitHub release-asset link, a Drive share page or a
GitHub blob link — known page shapes are auto-converted (src/lib/apk-url.ts).
releaseNotes: Same features: dashboard, ledger, budgets, reports, recurring, backups
New version system with splash-screen update checks
